stem: What is the most likely reason why the author is glad that he agreed to Hallie's request?

options.label: A
options.text: He witnesses Hallie capturing the largest crab she has ever chased.

options.label: B
options.text: He understands that catching such a large crab can be a challenging task.

options.label: C
options.text: He recognizes that finding money on the beach at night is an unusual event.

options.label: D
options.text: He realizes that Hallie is reaching an age when she will no longer want to chase crabs.
